text_block_list.text:
"A mile race where nobody could let their 
guard down for a second, truly fitting of 
a GⅠ. Amidst the palpable tension, Sweep 
Tosho fought tooth and nail for the win 
until the very end—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh, did you see that final stretch?! 
Look at that tenacity!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
A dreamlike run where you can't even tell 
where she flew in from...! That's— that's 
Sweep Tosho for you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Sweeep! Do your best at the Takarazuka 
Kinen! No... win it!! We're all cheering 
for you!!
(WAAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: People with Smartphones
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! What an incccredible race the 
Yasuda Kinen was!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Right. It should be over by now...

text_block_list.name: People with Smartphones
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, that was crazy intense!! Did 
you see how it ended!? Sweep Tosho 
totally—!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I don't need to hear the details to know 
the result. I'm sure Sweep ran a 
magnificent race and captured the hearts 
of the entire audience.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"And then you come to the Takarazuka 
Kinen. Carrying with you the strength to 
turn a fairytale like changing the world 
with magic into reality."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Because you're that kind of person.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Because you're so cool like that, I'm 
sure that I..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I've always wanted to be your rival.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yes, hello?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm fine, I'll be back before the 
promised time! Yes... yes, thank you for 
your concern.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then, after this— Looking forward to 
training together, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Phew—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Alright...!!

A witch who has finally perfected her 
spell, or a hero who has awakened.

Who becomes the protagonist of this story— 
will be decided at the Takarazuka Kinen.
